definitions.explanation: explaining or justifying one's actions, often to avoid blame or criticism

examples.japanese: {弁解|べんかい}の{余地|よち}がない。
examples.english: There is no room for excuses.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{遅刻|ちこく}の{弁解|べんかい}をしようとした。
examples.english: He tried to make an excuse for being late.

examples.japanese: {弁解|べんかい}がましいことは{言|い}いたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to make excuse-like statements.

examples.japanese: どんな{弁解|べんかい}も{通|とお}用しない{状況|じょうきょう}だった。
examples.english: It was a situation where no excuse would work.

notes:
{弁解|べんかい} refers to explaining or justifying one's actions, typically when facing criticism or blame. It often carries a slightly negative nuance of making excuses.

WRITING:
- {弁|べん} (speak, explain, argue)
- {解|かい} (solve, explain, untie)

USAGE:
- {弁解|べんかい}する (to make an excuse, to justify - suru verb)
- {弁解|べんかい}の{余地|よち}がない (no room for excuses)
- {弁解|べんかい}がましい (excuse-like, seeming to make excuses)
- Can be neutral (explanation) or negative (excuse-making)
- Often implies the speaker is at fault
- More formal than {言|い}い{訳|わけ} (excuse - colloquial)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {弁解|べんかい}を{試|こころ}みる (to attempt an excuse)
- {弁解|べんかい}に{終始|しゅうし}する (to end up just making excuses)
- {苦|くる}しい{弁解|べんかい} (a weak/painful excuse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弁明|べんめい} - more formal defense/vindication
- {釈明|しゃくめい} - more formal explanation/clarification
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ} - casual excuse

RELATED WORDS:
- {弁明|べんめい} (vindication, explanation)
- {言|い}い{訳|わけ} (excuse)
- {釈明|しゃくめい} (explanation, clarification)
- {正当化|せいとうか} (justification)
